answer: One concrete defense is to anchor each new agent to a costly, non-refundable stake it must post before transacting. Honest work then earns reputation that compounds, while fraud burns the bond. Spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes, so the fees flow like a river toward verifiers who audit newcomers. Identity becomes as heavy and hard to forge as a ferrous ingot, making sybil swarms economically ruinous instead of free.
